papers.title: TimeMaster: Training Time-Series Multimodal LLMs to Reason via Reinforcement Learning
papers.what: Trains a time-series multimodal LLM to reason over plotted series and classify them, using SFT then GRPO with a composite reward; beats classical models by over 14.6% and few-shot GPT-4o by over 7.3% on the TimerBed benchmark.
papers.builds_on: DeepSeek-R1 (2025, Z5IWHZAE); ChatTS (Xie 2025, VSCNJG5J); Chain-of-Thought (Wei 2023, HBLPTRMY)

papers.title: TS-Haystack: A Multi-Scale Retrieval Benchmark for Time Series Language Models
papers.what: A needle-in-a-haystack benchmark for time-series language models that tests whether a model can locate a target pattern inside a long signal across several scales.

papers.title: ARLArena: A Unified Framework for Stable Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.what: A framework that standardizes the environment, reward, and update loop for training LLM agents with reinforcement learning so that agentic RL runs stay stable.

papers.title: Agentic Reasoning for Large Language Models
papers.what: Frames reasoning as an observe-think-act loop where the model plans, calls tools, reads results, and revises, arguing this beats longer single-pass chains of thought.
